building: Kappa Kappa Gamma, Gamma Delta chapter
work_status: Detailed exterior and schematic interior built; fresh-open validation passed; independent 8.5/10 PASS recorded; awaiting coordinator master integration.

gis.source_uncertainty: The official campus polygon is not a certified survey and publishes no positional uncertainty. The NUM_LEVELS=1 and Extrution=12 attributes conflict with the photographed multi-story house and have undocumented units/semantics; neither was used as a measured height.

coordinate_method.axes_and_units: X east, Y north, Z up; meters
coordinate_method.method_limit: Project local approximation, not a surveyed CRS. Structural shell perimeter was created from all 12 distinct source-ring vertices; separate window/trim details expand the visible asset envelope slightly.
coordinate_method.measurement_status: GIS ring-derived plan dimensions; not a surveyed wall outline.

observations: dark multicolored blue-green slate mansard roof with dormers
courtyard-facing entry with KKG letters above the threshold
U/notched wings enclosing a planted courtyard
exterior_references.limits: Official but not current; image provides appearance and broad geometry only, not dimensions, precise bearing, or current condition.

exterior_references.provider: Kappa Kappa Gamma Gamma Delta official chapter website
exterior_references.use: Confirms the active Gamma Delta chapter and current site. Its current home page and Our Home page contain generic housing copy, not an identifiable current exterior/interior photo or floor plan.
exterior_references.limits: The live KKG chapter site is generic housing information and does not establish present room layouts.

exterior_references.use: Site plan labels Kappa Kappa Gamma Sorority at 325 Waldron St, corroborating present site identity/address.
exterior_references.limits: Adjacent redevelopment plan, not building elevation or interior evidence.

interior_references.provider: The Key, Kappa Kappa Gamma, Vol. 76 No. 2, Spring 1959, pp. 6-7
interior_references.observation: The chapter history describes a basement chapter room with blue tile and platform, a first-floor green slate entry hall and dining/lounge spaces, and added upper-floor dormitory rooms. Historic interior photos show dining and lounge rooms.
interior_references.limits: Historical renovation-era evidence, not a current measured/as-built plan. The current house may have changed since 1959.

interior_references.provider: The Key, Kappa Kappa Gamma, Vol. 131 No. 2, Summer 2014, p. 11
interior_references.observation: Identifies Gamma Delta at Purdue, reports the house was built in 1935 with two additions, and describes the blue shutters, KKÎ“ over the threshold, marble floor motif, and basement movie-night use.
interior_references.limits: Descriptive article; no measured plans or current interior photographs.

interior_references.provider: The Key, Kappa Kappa Gamma, Vol. 54 No. 1, February 1937
interior_references.observation: Contemporary house description identifies a basement chapter room, first-floor central hall/living/dining rooms, second-floor studies/bedrooms and third-floor dormitories under the roof.
interior_references.limits: Historic organization/layout description, not a contemporary as-built drawing.

design_decisions_and_limits.height: Two masonry wall levels with a dormered mansard roof were modeled from the 2017 official photo. Approximate above-grade roof height is 10.74 m; no reliable measured height or elevation was found. A basement extends to -2.8 m as an interior visualization estimate.
design_decisions_and_limits.roof_and_form: Notched official GIS footprint preserved. Dark blue-green mansard roof with one row of four dormers on the courtyard-facing slope follows the four dormers visible in the 2017 photo. Roof wing segmentation, ridge/cap proportions, and unseen roof elevations remain estimates.
design_decisions_and_limits.interior: One schematic embedded interior mesh; historic room uses inform a basement chapter room, first-floor entry/common space and upper bedrooms. Exact room boundaries, furnishings, finishes and current uses remain unverified.
design_decisions_and_limits.textures: Procedural Blender noise/color-ramp/bump node materials; no external image assets or absolute texture paths.
design_decisions_and_limits.placement: Asset remains a direct campus-coordinate massing library with the original object, scene, collection, ID, path and XY footprint. Master blend and shared placement data were not edited.

geometry_edits: Replaced the capped full-footprint wall extrusion with uncapped perimeter walls, removing the unintended pale top surface while preserving the source-derived plan outline and interior floor plates.

Brightened the cream masonry, revised roof material tones and broad sloped fields to read as dark multitone blue-green slate, and positioned a single row of four dormers on the photographed courtyard-facing slope.
Added a centered raised KKG plaque/lettering treatment above the entry. Letter legibility in the close render remains for independent review.
No GIS height attributes were treated as measured elevations.

build_and_validation.interior_cutaway_method: A temporary render copy removes roof/upper-level faces and opens the first-floor slab faces for an oblique view into schematic partitions and common-room furnishings. The saved building asset was not changed by the cutaway render.
build_and_validation.result: Passed after wall-shell, roof, and entry revisions; stable scene/object/collection, one mesh object, 9,040 vertices, 6,767 faces, 14 procedural material slots, zero external image dependencies.

independent_grade.grader: Alpha Gamma Delta builder, read-only independent review delegated by coordinator
independent_grade.notes: Reviewer noted that the saved 2017 photo supports the cream ashlar, blue shutters, slate mansard, four dormers, courtyard entry, and source-derived GIS ring. Floor-slab projections remain visible in exterior renders and plaque lettering is hard to read. No asset or preview edits were made after the passing review.

coordinator_status: Independently graded above 8/10; integrated and fresh-open verified in the master.
